Unemployment rates should be of concern because they directly affect the welfare of individuals and contribute to economic instability. High unemployment can lead to reduced income, decreased purchasing power, and higher levels of poverty. Additionally, prolonged periods of unemployment can result in skill degradation and loss of job-specific knowledge, making it harder for individuals to find employment in the future. Furthermore, high unemployment can strain social services and increase the burden on government budgets.
